# Secure the Work.

## Trust Citrix to deliver improved user experiences, more productivity, and tailored security at an
## optimized cost.

[Learn more][72]
[
1:03
[Citrix: Secure the Work.]
][73]

ANNOUNCING

## **Citrix Platform Flex is here**

A persona-based platform for secure application access, managed services, and
observability—delivered through a flexible license model with predictable cost.

[Explore Citrix Platform Flex][74]

## **Citrix solutions by industry**

### **Healthcare IT solutions**

With over 4,300 healthcare customers worldwide, Citrix is the leader in delivering secure, scalable,
and resilient solutions to healthcare customers for over 3 decades.

[Read more on Citrix healthcare solutions][75]

### **Financial services IT solutions**

With the Citrix platform, financial services institutions including banks, brokerages, investment
firms, and insurance companies can provide employees and customers with instant secure access to
apps and data on any device.

[Read more on Citrix financial services solutions][76]

### **Government IT solutions**

Citrix solutions for  Government enable you to manage and optimize Citrix workloads from a
cloud-based management portal, regardless of whether they are running on a government-grade cloud
offering or your on-premises environments.

[Read more on Citrix government solutions][77]

## **One platform, many solutions—do more with Citrix**

Explore new use cases made possible with Citrix and NetScaler

### **Centralize app and desktop management**

Support distributed workforces by centralizing the management of apps to any device

[Read more][78]

### **Deliver mission critical applications**

Adapt access based on device posture and risk factors, without compromising on user experience

[Read more][79]

### **Protect sensitive business information**

Seamlessly extend your existing Citrix and NetScaler^{®} infrastructure to provide zero trust app
access for SaaS and web applications

[Read more][80

# Detect, fix, and validate IT issues before users notice
* [ Explore TeamViewer DEX ][119]
* [ Find out more ][120]

TeamViewer DEX combines real-time endpoint visibility, insights, and automated remediation to
prevent IT issues before they disrupt work.
* ### Frictionless experience
  
  Ensures a smooth and uninterrupted digital experience for employees, minimizing frustrations and
  unnecessary disruptions.
* ### Seamless IT operations
  
  Optimize processes with enhanced visibility and automation, driving proactive remediations,
  exceptional service, and reduced costs.
* ### Real-time service desk troubleshooting and resolution
  
  Resolve IT issues proactively and in real-time to reduce service desk incidents, minimize
  downtime, and maintain smooth, efficient operations.
* ### Autonomous digital experience management
  
  Identify, notify, and fix compliance drift, digital friction, and end-user frustration issues.

Trusted by IT teams around the world

  downtime, and maintain smooth, efficient operations.

traffic.

[Acronis]

## GenAI Protection

NEW

Businesses want the benefits of AI, but not the risk. They already use AI tools for research,
writing, coding, and customer communication but often without control or visibility. This creates
shadow AI, data exposure, and compliance gaps. Now MSPs can change that. Deliver secure AI
productivity as managed services, fully integrated into the platform you already operate, with
governance, visibility, and protection built in.

[Acronis]

## Detection and Response

Acronis EDR and XDR helps you protect clients against threats and comply with cyber insurance
requirements. With complete protection spanning the NIST framework, Acronis EDR and XDR enabling
MSPs with data governance / compliance and the ability to identify, protect, detect, respond and
recover from threats. In addition to EDR & XDR, Acronis also offers MDR so that MSPs can offer their
clients a fully managed service with minimal resource investment.

[Acronis]

## SaaS Security

Detect, block and remediate advanced email and cloud application threats with AI-powered solutions
that protect your clients from the #1 threat vector. Acronis Email Security (for Microsoft 365 and
Google Workspace) and Collaboration Security (for Microsoft 365) provides the ease of use that MSPs
need.

[Acronis]

## Backup

Protect clients’ data no matter where it might reside across physical, virtual and cloud-based
environments. Acronis backup protects more than 20 workload types from one console and features
file-level, disk-level, image and application backups, along with hybrid storage options,
incremental and differential backups, and more.

[Acronis]

## Disaster Recovery

Rapidly recover from ransomware, cyberthreats and other unplanned outages. Acronis Disaster Recovery
empowers MSPs to restore operations in just a few clicks and deliver disaster recovery services with
ease. With fast recovery, three-click setup and a single console, Acronis Disaster Recovery provides
a single solution for any workload.

[Acronis]

## HCI & IaaS

Deliver infrastructure services on your own terms with Acronis Cyber Frame — a secure hyperconverged
infrastructure (HCI) and infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) solution built specifically for service
providers. It enables you to provision and manage virtual machines, storage and networking with
built-in cyber protection, management and automation. Built on optimized OpenStack and the KVM
hypervisor, it supports multitenancy, white-label delivery and two deployment models: Acronis-hosted
and SP-hosted deployment.

[Acronis]

## RMM

Achieve peak MSP performance with a natively integrated, secure, AI-powered RMM that provides
seamless automation of IT management to boost technician performance. With Acronis RMM, MSPs can
deliver superior IT administration and monitoring services while improving security posture for both
endpoints and Microsoft 365.

[Acronis]

## PSA

Simplify success with an easy-to-deploy, adopt and use PSA tailored for modern recurring and cloud
MSP business models. Acronis PSA features service desk, billing and invoicing, contract and
quotation management, stock inventory and project management, and insightful KPI reports. Part of
Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud, Acronis PSA is natively integrated with Acronis RMM, cybersecurity and
data protection in a single console and offers comprehensive integrations with third-party RMM and
accounting systems.

[Acronis]

## GenAI Protection

NEW

Businesses want the benefits of AI, but not the risk. They already use AI tools for research,
writing, coding, and customer communication but often without control or visibility. This creates
shadow AI, data exposure, and compliance gaps. Now MSPs can change that. Deliver secure AI
productivity as managed services, fully integrated into the platform you already operate, with
governance, visibility, and protection built in.

[Acronis]

## Detection and Response

Acronis EDR and XDR helps you protect clients against threats and comply with cyber insurance
requirements. With complete protection spanning the NIST framework, Acronis EDR and XDR enabling
MSPs with data governance / compliance and the ability to identify, protect, detect, respond and
recover from threats. In addition to EDR & XDR, Acronis also offers MDR so that MSPs can offer their
clients a fully managed service with minimal resource investment.

[Acronis]

## SaaS Security

Detect, block and remediate advanced email and cloud application threats with AI-powered solutions
that protect your clients from the #1 threat vector. Acronis Email Security (for Microsoft 365 and
Google Workspace) and Collaboration Security (for Microsoft 365) provides the ease of use that MSPs
need.

[Acronis]

## Backup

Protect clients’ data no matter where it might reside across physical, virtual and cloud-based
environments. Acronis backup protects more than 20 workload types from one console and features
file-level, disk-level, image and application backups, along with hybrid storage options,
incremental and differential backups, and more.

[Acronis]

## Disaster Recovery

Rapidly recover from ransomware, cyberthreats and other unplanned outages. Acronis Disaster Recovery
empowers MSPs to restore operations in just a few clicks and deliver disaster recovery services with
ease. With fast recovery, three-click setup and a single console, Acronis Disaster Recovery provides
a single solution for any workload.

[Acronis]

## HCI & IaaS

Deliver infrastructure services on your own terms with Acronis Cyber Frame — a secure hyperconverged
infrastructure (HCI) and infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) solution built specifically for service
providers. It enables you to provision and manage virtual machines, storage and networking with
built-in cyber protection, management and automation. Built on optimized OpenStack and the KVM
hypervisor, it supports multitenancy, white-label delivery and two deployment models: Acronis-hosted
and SP-hosted deployment.

[Acronis]

## RMM

Achieve peak MSP performance with a natively integrated, secure, AI-powered RMM that provides
seamless automation of IT management to boost technician performance. With Acronis RMM, MSPs can
deliver superior IT administration and monitoring services while improving security posture for both
endpoints and Microsoft 365.

[Acronis]

## PSA

Simplify success with an easy-to-deploy, adopt and use PSA tailored for modern recurring and cloud
MSP business models. Acronis PSA features service desk, billing and invoicing, contract and
quotation management, stock inventory and project management, and insightful KPI reports. Part of
Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud, Acronis PSA is natively integrated with Acronis RMM, cybersecurity and
data protection in a single console and offers comprehensive integrations with third-party RMM and
accounting systems.

### Govern AI Agents Before They Govern Themselves

AI agents are the fastest-growing class of privileged identity in the enterprise, and the least
governed. They request access, execute actions, and escalate privileges at machine speed.
BeyondTrust discovers agentic identities across AWS, Azure, Google, OpenAI, Salesforce, and
ServiceNow, then enforces the same privilege controls that secure your human administrators. One
framework for every identity type.
[https://images.ctfassets.net/ahmdpntb02m6/5tVZtsP8tLWbcP3bpKOKSS/2557ff71f57a9ec1f35b66644aeb3a3e/b
ento1-1.jpg?fm=webp&q=65]

### Map Every Path to Privilege™ Before Attackers Do

Other vendors see the org chart. We see the attack graph. True Privilege™ maps what every identity
can actually do through lateral movement, shadow access paths, and inherited entitlements. Discover
hidden Paths to Privilege across your entire estate, human, non-human, and AI, and eliminate them
before a compromised identity becomes a breach.
[https://images.ctfassets.net/ahmdpntb02m6/3iOa1p3jJvz32ZHMMxsAlX/8f02f279fe5c837a12efdce6236c5d4e/b
ento-4.jpg?fm=webp&q=65]

### Eliminate VPNs, and Securely Empower Service Desks and Vendors

Third-parties and service desks are unsung heroes, and prime targets for MFA bypass, phishing, and
supply chain attacks. Our zero trust access solution, including Remote Support, manages credentials,
enforces JIT access, and manages sessions. Extend PAM to every corner of your IT/OT estate, while
streamlining workflows via integrations with ServiceNow and other tooling.
[https://images.ctfassets.net/ahmdpntb02m6/5zPTN6iJR4xo2l7yg0refG/e52078ba1114e53a9dc24d5e29fb3707/b
ento-2.jpg?fm=webp&q=65]
[Enforce Zero Standing Privilege]

### Enforce Zero Standing Privilege

Standing access is an open invitation. We close it. Remove standing privilege across endpoints,
cloud, SaaS, and OT with just-in-time access that grants the right privilege, to the right identity,
for the right duration, then auto-revokes it. Vault and rotate what you must. Eliminate what you
can.

The BeyondTrust Pathfinder Platform unifies PAM, ITDR, Secrets Management, CIEM, and Secure Remote

# Secure Every Identity. Across Every Environment.

## Discover All Your Identity Risk Pathways

[https://images.ctfassets.net/ahmdpntb02m6/73Z1HCn6tZyiLaw95LFN94/113239cbf3c1269228e28381ef1d497d/b
ento-3.jpg?fm=webp&q=65]
[Govern AI Agents Before They Govern Themselves]

### Govern AI Agents Before They Govern Themselves

AI agents are the fastest-growing class of privileged identity in the enterprise, and the least
governed. They request access, execute actions, and escalate privileges at machine speed.
BeyondTrust discovers agentic identities across AWS, Azure, Google, OpenAI, Salesforce, and
ServiceNow, then enforces the same privilege controls that secure your human administrators. One
framework for every identity type.
[https://images.ctfassets.net/ahmdpntb02m6/5tVZtsP8tLWbcP3bpKOKSS/2557ff71f57a9ec1f35b66644aeb3a3e/b
ento1-1.jpg?fm=webp&q=65]
[Map Every Path to Privilege™ Before Attackers Do]

### Map Every Path to Privilege™ Before Attackers Do

Other vendors see the org chart. We see the attack graph. True Privilege™ maps what every identity
can actually do through lateral movement, shadow access paths, and inherited entitlements. Discover
hidden Paths to Privilege across your entire estate, human, non-human, and AI, and eliminate them
before a compromised identity becomes a breach.
[https://images.ctfassets.net/ahmdpntb02m6/3iOa1p3jJvz32ZHMMxsAlX/8f02f279fe5c837a12efdce6236c5d4e/b
ento-4.jpg?fm=webp&q=65]
[Eliminate VPNs, and Securely Empower Service Desks and Vendors]

### Eliminate VPNs, and Securely Empower Service Desks and Vendors

Third-parties and service desks are unsung heroes, and prime targets for MFA bypass, phishing, and
supply chain attacks. Our zero trust access solution, including Remote Support, manages credentials,
enforces JIT access, and manages sessions. Extend PAM to every corner of your IT/OT estate, while
streamlining workflows via integrations with ServiceNow and other tooling.
[https://images.ctfassets.net/ahmdpntb02m6/5zPTN6iJR4xo2l7yg0refG/e52078ba1114e53a9dc24d5e29fb3707/b
ento-2.jpg?fm=webp&q=65]
[Enforce Zero Standing Privilege]

### Enforce Zero Standing Privilege

Standing access is an open invitation. We close it. Remove standing privilege across endpoints,
cloud, SaaS, and OT with just-in-time access that grants the right privilege, to the right identity,
for the right duration, then auto-revokes it. Vault and rotate what you must. Eliminate what you
can.

## One Platform. Every Identity.
## Every Environment.

### You can’t secure connected risk with disconnected tools.

The BeyondTrust Pathfinder Platform unifies PAM, ITDR, Secrets Management, CIEM, and Secure Remote
Access—so you can see, understand, and control identities as a single, connected system across every
domain.

# FortiGate VM and CNF: Cloud network security for any scenario.

The same award-winning FortiGate network security trusted by over 775,000 organizations is available
in two cloud options designed to secure any cloud-native, hybrid, and multi-cloud environment.

[COMPARE SOLUTIONS][3]

# FortiGate VM

Where security and networking converge.

[Choose Marketplace][4]

# FortiGate CNF

Cloud-native firewall made easy.

[Explore][5]
[Benefits][6] [Compare VM and CNF][7] [Strengthen Security][8] [Resources][9]
[CHOOSE MARKETPLACE][10]

## Solve the complexities of cloud network security.

The cloud brings undeniable agility and scalability benefits but can introduce unique security
challenges. Traditional on-premises or cloud-provided security solutions struggle to provide
consistency, visibility, and scale to keep pace with dynamic cloud deployments and ever-evolving
threats.

# FortiGate VM and Cloud-Native Firewall (CNF) bring you comprehensive protection and consistent
# policies—fast.

Getting started is easy and familiar with the same operating system across all Fortinet solutions.
Adopt the policies, configurations, and workflows that you've already built and currently use in
your existing infrastructure to reduce overhead and configuration time, and get consistent
protection faster.

[EXPLORE SOLUTIONS][11]

## Challenge

## Solution

Lack of Visibility Across Environments

### Unmatched Visibility

Gain centralized visibility and control over your networks to minimize blind spots.

Managing Disparate Security Tools

### Simplified Management

Manage your entire security infrastructure from a single pane of glass and unified operating system.

Difficulty With Scalability

### Effortless Scalability

Scales effortlessly to meet the dynamic security needs of your hybrid and multi-cloud environment.

Inconsistent Security Policies

### Consistent Security Policies

Enforce consistent security policies across your entire network, regardless of location.

# Which is right for you?

Whether you require the flexibility of a virtual machine deployment in FortiGate VM, or the inherent
scalability and automation of a cloud-native firewall solution with FortiGate CNF, Fortinet offers a
tailored security solution to perfectly match your specific cloud network security needs.

# FortiGate VM

FortiGate VM delivers converged networking and security everywhere you need it with built-in SD-WAN
and remote access VPN.

It is ideal for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, offering granular control and flexibility with
the same familiar interface and features as our award-winning hardware firewalls.

[Choose Marketplace][12]

# FortiGate CNF

FortiGate CNF is a Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS) that's perfect for cloud-native deployments where
workloads reside entirely within the cloud environment.

It prioritizes ease of deployment and automatic scaling for dynamic cloud workloads, without the
added infrastructure management of a full virtual firewall.

[Explore][13]

## Explore FortiGate VM and FortiGate CNF.

Deployment Model

### FortiGate VM

Virtual Machine (IaaS)

### FortiGate CNF

Cloud-native (SaaS), deployed in minutes

Feature Set

### FortiGate VM

NGFW, VPN, NAT, SD-WAN, Zero Trust Enforcement

### FortiGate CNF

NGFW with cloud-native features

Network Operations

### FortiGate VM

More involved, requiring network design, deployment, and management

### FortiGate CNF

Simple, the underlying infrastructure and maintenance is managed by Fortinet for zero operations
overhead

Scalability

### FortiGate VM

Built using FortiOS-native high availability (HA) features and cloud deployment templates

### FortiGate CNF

Built-in automatic scaling is available for both AWS- and Azure-based deployments

Security

Complete security effectiveness and threat protection that basic firewalls can't match.

Powered by FortiGuard Labs AI- and ML-based threat intelligence to stay ahead of the latest threats

Best-Fit Use Cases

### FortiGate VM

Versatile and customizable, especially where networking is required, such as:
* Adopting hybrid and multi-cloud deployments
* Lift-and-shift migrations to cloud
* Moving legacy, monolithic applications to cloud without or with minor refactoring to use virtual
  resources
* Securing N/S and E/W traffic both within and across platforms
* Converged networking and security with full-stack routing
* Organizations implementing Universal ZTNA

### FortiGate CNF

Focused on cloud workloads, automation, and scalability with simplified management:
* Designing new cloud-native applications or migrating with major re-architecting to take advantage
  of cloud capabilities
* Creating virtual barriers for each cloud environment to protect networks, workloads, and
  applications
* Moving part of workloads to the cloud to support bursts in demand
* Addressing scalability for workloads with unknown demand

Price Options

### FortiGate VM
* 30-Day Free Trial

## Solve the complexities of cloud network security.

The cloud brings undeniable agility and scalability benefits but can introduce unique security
challenges. Traditional on-premises or cloud-provided security solutions struggle to provide
consistency, visibility, and scale to keep pace with dynamic cloud deployments and ever-evolving
threats.

# FortiGate VM and Cloud-Native Firewall (CNF) bring you comprehensive protection and consistent
# policies—fast.

Getting started is easy and familiar with the same operating system across all Fortinet solutions.
Adopt the policies, configurations, and workflows that you've already built and currently use in
your existing infrastructure to reduce overhead and configuration time, and get consistent
protection faster.

[EXPLORE SOLUTIONS][11]

## Challenge

## Solution

Lack of Visibility Across Environments

### Unmatched Visibility

Gain centralized visibility and control over your networks to minimize blind spots.

Managing Disparate Security Tools

### Simplified Management

Manage your entire security infrastructure from a single pane of glass and unified operating system.

Difficulty With Scalability

### Effortless Scalability

Scales effortlessly to meet the dynamic security needs of your hybrid and multi-cloud environment.

Inconsistent Security Policies

### Consistent Security Policies

Enforce consistent security policies across your entire network, regardless of location.

# Which is right for you?

Whether you require the flexibility of a virtual machine deployment in FortiGate VM, or the inherent
scalability and automation of a cloud-native firewall solution with FortiGate CNF, Fortinet offers a
tailored security solution to perfectly match your specific cloud network security needs.

# FortiGate VM

FortiGate VM delivers converged networking and security everywhere you need it with built-in SD-WAN
and remote access VPN.

It is ideal for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, offering granular control and flexibility with
the same familiar interface and features as our award-winning hardware firewalls.

[Choose Marketplace][12]

# FortiGate CNF

FortiGate CNF is a Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS) that's perfect for cloud-native deployments where
workloads reside entirely within the cloud environment.

It prioritizes ease of deployment and automatic scaling for dynamic cloud workloads, without the
added infrastructure management of a full virtual firewall.

Best-Fit Use Cases

### FortiGate VM

Versatile and customizable, especially where networking is required, such as:
* Adopting hybrid and multi-cloud deployments
* Lift-and-shift migrations to cloud
* Moving legacy, monolithic applications to cloud without or with minor refactoring to use virtual
  resources
* Securing N/S and E/W traffic both within and across platforms
* Converged networking and security with full-stack routing
* Organizations implementing Universal ZTNA

### FortiGate CNF

Focused on cloud workloads, automation, and scalability with simplified management:
* Designing new cloud-native applications or migrating with major re-architecting to take advantage

* Creating virtual barriers for each cloud environment to protect networks, workloads, and
  applications
* Moving part of workloads to the cloud to support bursts in demand
* Addressing scalability for workloads with unknown demand

## All-inclusive Disk Partition Toolkit

Give you all the necessary tools to optimize, protect and manage your hard drives and data.

#### Manage

As a fully developed partition manager, AOMEI Partition Assistant strives to optimize disk usage for
Windows users without any data loss. It allows you to quickly create, delete, format, resize, move,
merge, wipe, and hide partitions to maximize disk space utilization, with a 100% success rate in
resizing.

#### Clone

You can easily migrate your OS from an MBR HDD to a GPT SSD without having to reinstall your
operating system and applications, making it simple to upgrade or replace your hard drive. This
utility is capable of cloning every bit of information from an entire partition or hard drive,
creating a 100% identical copy of the original device.

#### Convert

Perform comprehensive conversion operations on your disk and partitions to manage storage space
efficiently and enhance the performance of your Windows computer. This utility allows you to convert
disks between MBR and GPT, basic and dynamic, as well as convert partitions between primary and
logical, and file systems between FAT32 and NTFS.

#### Security

Protect your important data with powerful security features such as secure data wiping to
permanently erase sensitive files, file shredding to prevent recovery, and advanced partition
encryption using BitLocker technology. These tools ensure your information remains confidential and
safe from unauthorized access or data breaches.

#### Health

Keep your hard drives running smoothly and reliably with comprehensive disk health management.
Perform disk defragmentation to optimize file storage, scan and repair bad sectors to prevent data
corruption, and continuously monitor the overall health of your drives. These features help to
extend the lifespan of your disks and safeguard your valuable data.

#### Tools

In addition to the features mentioned above, AOMEI Partition Assistant also offers more advanced
capabilities. For example, the ‘Windows 11 Checker’ allows you to check if your PC is capable of
upgrading to Windows 11. You can also create a bootable USB/ISO/CD of your OS to quickly repair a PC
that fails to start.

## One Brand. More Possibilities

Explore more members of AOMEI Partition Assistant family. We've got you covered with everything you
need for a better digital life.

This website uses cookies so that we can provide you with the best user experience possible. Cookie

**1. Privacy Policy Statement**

M2M One is committed to protecting your privacy, keeping your information safe and ensuring the
security of your data. This policy outlines our ongoing obligations to you in respect of how we
manage your Personal Information. This extends to both our control and processing of personal
information.

We have adopted the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) contained in the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth)
(the Privacy Act). The National Privacy Principles (NPPs) govern the way in which we collect, use,
disclose, store, secure and dispose your Personal Information.

The current policy will be in effect from 1 July 2020. We may need to update it over time but if we
do, the updated version will be published.

**2. What information we collect and control**

The types of information we collect depends on how you use our products and services as well as the
relationship we have with you as a customer. It may include information like your name, date of
birth, contact details (including address, email address, phone number or mobile telephone number),
bank account and credit card details, information to prove your identity (driver’s license or
another approved ID), account username or password and your use of our products and services.

We may also collect more in-depth information including:
* **Financial and Credit information **related to your financial relationship with us, such as your
  financial details, payment history, credit history, and your service history.
* **Information about your products and services including** device-specific information such as
  your hardware model, operating system version, unique device and service identifiers, device
  status, serial numbers, settings, configuration and software and mobile network information.
* **Information about how you use your products and services such as:**
* Your network usage including time and duration of your communications as well as information about
  the operation of the equipment, services and applications you use on our networks
* How you use our services to access the internet, such as the location of your devices when you are
  using our products and services
* Information that allows us to identify you for verification purposes.

## Replace your legacy VPN

On

[NetBird.io]
NetBird's SDN eliminates the complexity of managing VPN gateways and firewall configurations,
connecting your resources directly and securely without single points of failure.
[NetBird Connect Off][NetBird Connect Off][NetBird Connect On][NetBird Connect On]

## Quickly organize remote access to resources anywhere

NetBird enables granular network segmentation, ensuring only authorized users access specific
resources, while letting you manage everything seamlessly from a single place.
[NetBird Secure][NetBird Secure]

## Three things you should know about NetBird

### It's simple and secure

Creating a NetBird network takes under 5 minutes, providing encrypted connections without complex
firewall setups. Its Zero Trust model ensures only authorized users and devices can access internal
resources.

### It connects anything anywhere

NetBird works on Linux, Windows, macOS, mobile devices, Docker containers, and even routers. It’s
infrastructure-agnostic, allowing seamless connectivity between resources across different clouds
and on-premises.

### It's open source

While you can always rely on NetBird Cloud, the platform is distributed under a permissive BSD-3
license and can be self-hosted on your servers, allowing users to review the code and run it on
their own infrastructure.

## What is DDNS?

[Dynamic DNS][99] (DDNS) is a service that automatically updates your domain name to match your
changing IP address. Most home internet connections use dynamic IPs, which can make it hard to
remotely access your networked devices. That’s where DDNS comes in.

## What is Managed DNS?

[Managed DNS][100] is a service that routes traffic to your domain name using a global network of
authoritative DNS servers. Instead of running and maintaining your own DNS infrastructure, managed
DNS lets you rely on a fast, secure, and redundant platform built for performance and uptime.

## What is DDNS?

[Dynamic DNS][99] (DDNS) is a service that automatically updates your domain name to match your
changing IP address. Most home internet connections use dynamic IPs, which can make it hard to
remotely access your networked devices. That’s where DDNS comes in.

## What is Managed DNS?

[Managed DNS][100] is a service that routes traffic to your domain name using a global network of
authoritative DNS servers. Instead of running and maintaining your own DNS infrastructure, managed
DNS lets you rely on a fast, secure, and redundant platform built for performance and uptime.

## What NovaSecure VPN does

NovaSecure VPN is designed to make your online activity more private and secure. Below is a quick
overview of how the app protects you.

🔒 Encrypted connection

NovaSecure VPN creates an encrypted tunnel between your device and our servers. This helps protect
your data from being intercepted by third parties, especially on public Wi-Fi networks.

🛡️ Privacy-focused design

We do not sell your personal data. Connection data is minimized and used only to provide and improve
the service in line with our privacy policy.

🌍 Global servers

Connect to different server locations to improve your connection stability and access
region-specific services where legally allowed.

📱 Easy to use

One-tap connect, clear status indicators, and helpful error messages make it simple to stay
protected even if you’re new to VPNs.

## Quick troubleshooting

If you are having trouble using NovaSecure VPN, try the steps below before contacting support.

Connection problems
* Check that your internet connection (Wi-Fi or mobile data) works without the VPN.
* Open NovaSecure VPN and tap “Disconnect”, then “Connect” again.
* Try switching to another server location inside the app.
* Restart your device if the issue continues.
Subscription or billing issues
* All payments and subscriptions on iOS are managed through your Apple ID.
* Go to **Settings > Your Name > Subscriptions** on your device to view or cancel your NovaSecure
  VPN subscription.
* For billing problems or refunds, please contact **Apple Support** directly, as developers cannot
  access your payment details.
How do I contact NovaSecure VPN support?
You can email us at [[email protected]][11]. Please include:
* Your device model (e.g., iPhone 14)
* Your iOS version (e.g., iOS 18.0)
* App version (found in the app settings)
* A clear, step-by-step description of the issue
What information does NovaSecure VPN collect?
We only collect the data necessary to operate and improve the service, such as basic diagnostics and
anonymized usage statistics. We do not inspect the content of your traffic. For full details, see
our [Privacy Policy][12] below.
Is it legal to use NovaSecure VPN?
VPN usage is legal in many countries, but local laws may differ. You are responsible for complying
with the laws and regulations of your country or region when using this app. NovaSecure VPN must not
be used for any illegal activities.
Does NovaSecure VPN guarantee 100% protection?
No security tool can guarantee 100% protection. NovaSecure VPN is one layer of protection that helps
secure your connection and improve your privacy, but you should still follow best practices such as
using strong passwords, keeping your device updated, and avoiding suspicious links and websites.

The Problem

## Infrastructure access is fragmented, risky, and painful to manage

Most teams still rely on a mix of VPNs, jump hosts, SSH key workflows, database tunnels, and
separate tools for internal apps. That creates operational overhead, weak visibility, and
unnecessary risk.

### Too many tools

VPN for network access, bastion for SSH, separate tooling for databases, Kubernetes, and internal
apps. Every tool adds complexity.

### Too much risk

Shared credentials, long-lived access, exposed ports, and limited visibility make audits and
incident response harder than they need to be.

### Too much friction

Engineers wait for access, onboarding takes too long, and admins spend time managing credentials
instead of policies.

The Solution

## One platform for secure access to everything your team needs

OnePAM replaces scattered access tooling with a unified platform for infrastructure access. Connect
your identity provider, define access policies, and let your team connect through browser, CLI, or
native clients — with every session authenticated, recorded, and auditable.

**Secure SSH access** with SSO and session recording
**Kubernetes access** without exposing clusters
**Database access** with RBAC and logging
**Browser-based RDP** and internal web app access
**Built-in MFA**, least privilege, and full audit trails
Why OnePAM

## Why teams switch to OnePAM

### Replace multiple tools

Stop stitching together VPNs, bastions, and manual credential workflows.

### Deploy fast

Get from signup to first session in minutes, not weeks.

### Improve security without slowing engineers down

Use identity-based access controls instead of shared credentials and static access.

### Be audit-ready by default

Every session is tied to a real identity, timestamp, and recorded activity.

Get Started

## Get started in 3 simple steps

Go from signup to fully secured access in minutes, not weeks.

1

### Connect your identity provider

Use Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, or any SAML / OIDC provider.

2

### Add your infrastructure

Register servers, databases, Kubernetes clusters, internal apps, and secure networks.

3

### Give secure access instantly

Your team signs in once and connects securely via browser, CLI, or GUI — with policies and recording
already applied.

Use Cases

### For DevOps teams

Give engineers fast access to servers, clusters, and databases without manual key management.

### For security teams

Centralize access control, enforce MFA and RBAC, and record every session for investigation and
compliance.

### For growing SaaS companies

## Implement Zero Trust without starting from zero

Join thousands of organizations that trust OpenVPN for secure, high-performance remote access that

[Get Started for Free][31][Schedule a Demo][32]

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a VPN?

A Virtual Private Network (VPN) provides your business with a securely encrypted internet connection
(or “tunnel”) to securely connect devices to business assets over otherwise unsecured networks.
VPNs, like OpenVPN, work by masking your IP address and encrypting your internet traffic. VPN
protection is an important piece of a layered security protocol that’s essential to protecting
company data as well as an employee's personal data. Using a VPN service gives you the ability to
remotely access important network resources and connect your company’s branches and locations
worldwide. A [zero trust VPN][33] offers the tenets of zero trust built on the solid foundation of a
VPN.

What do VPNs do?

VPNs encrypt traffic, protect privacy, and enable secure remote access. A [remote access VPN][34]
connection secures your internet connection when you work off-site (e.g., coffee shop, hotel,
airport, or even a different country), and routes all of your sensitive network traffic through an
encrypted tunnel. Routing the network traffic disguises your IP address when using the internet,
replacing it with the location and an IP address from the VPN server making its location invisible.
A VPN connection also secures against external breaches.

What is a VPN server?

VPNs work by routing traffic through a private server. If you are using a self-managed VPN solution
like [Access Server][35], you can choose a physical server, or your VPN server can be hosted in
cloud environments. [VPN server resources][36] can help you simplify setting up your own private
server. Alternatively, you can choose a managed VPN solution, like [CloudConnexa][37], which
utilizes cloud-based servers managed by OpenVPN. In any case, the VPN will route all traffic through
a server.

What does a business VPN do?

A [business VPN][38] creates a secure connection over the internet between your devices and your
company's network. Essentially, a VPN creates a protected, encrypted tunnel through which your
sensitive data can travel, providing protection from intruders and a virtual connection to your
office network. Unlike a consumer VPN, which targets mainly personal users who are looking to
protect traffic, access the internet anonymously, or possibly access resources from other regions, a
business VPN is intended for remote and secure access to business resources on corporate private
networks with centralized control capabilities.

What VPN should I use for my business?

OpenVPN offers two secure networking solutions for small, medium, and enterprise [businesses like
yours][39].

[Access Server][40] is best for businesses that prefer an on-prem VPN server or flexibility managing
their full infrastructure through a cloud server. Choose [CloudConnexa][41] if you prefer a
cloud-delivered, managed service.

Our [product comparison][42] can help you choose the right solution for your business.

How much does a VPN cost for a small business?

OpenVPN offers solutions that can fit your budget. Whether you are looking for a [VPN for a small
business][43] or an enterprise, OpenVPN has plans starting at $7 per month per concurrent
connection, and offers a free trial to get started. Find out [how much a VPN costs for your business
size and number of connections here][44].

Can I use a VPN for free?

OpenVPN offers up to 5 free seats and a free trial for CloudConnexa, and 2 free connections for
Access Server. This makes it possible to use a [free VPN for small teams][45]. Teams will have full
functionality of OpenVPN with both the free trial and the free connections.

What is a Zero Trust VPN?

A Zero Trust VPN uses a VPN as the foundation of zero trust network access. Access Server and
CloudConnexa can be used to implement a zero trust network access solution that secures your network
resources while limiting access to only what is necessary.

What is Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)?

According to [Gartner][46], “[Zero trust network access (ZTNA)][47] is a product or service that
creates an identity- and context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of
applications.” Doing this hides the apps from discovery and restricts access using a trust broker
and a set of named entities. The broker verifies users based on identity, context, and policies —
and stops lateral movement in the network. Because application assets are removed from public
visibility, potential [attack surface][48] is reduced.

ZTNA also relies on least privilege access, which means that employees should only have access to
the programs and applications that are necessary to do their jobs. Using a VPN, you can enforce the
tenets of ZTNA and build the foundation for the principle of least privilege.

Where can I find information on OpenVPN’s pricing?

OpenVPN has transparent, flexible pricing that fits all budgets. Starting at just $7 per connection
per month, you can see a customized price based on your business size [here][49].

Does OpenVPN allow cancellation without notice?

You can cancel your subscription at any time and unused funds will be credited to your account for
future usage. For refunds, contact [sales@openvpn.net][50].

Where can I learn about OpenVPN’s compliance and security measures?

OpenVPN is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant, and performs ongoing security assessments. [Learn more about
our compliance here][51].

Where can I find OpenVPN technical support?

OpenVPN technical support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week through our [ support
portal][52].

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is a VPN?

A Virtual Private Network (VPN) provides your business with a securely encrypted internet connection
(or “tunnel”) to securely connect devices to business assets over otherwise unsecured networks.
VPNs, like OpenVPN, work by masking your IP address and encrypting your internet traffic. VPN
protection is an important piece of a layered security protocol that’s essential to protecting
company data as well as an employee's personal data. Using a VPN service gives you the ability to
remotely access important network resources and connect your company’s branches and locations
worldwide. A [zero trust VPN][33] offers the tenets of zero trust built on the solid foundation of a
VPN.

What do VPNs do?

VPNs encrypt traffic, protect privacy, and enable secure remote access. A [remote access VPN][34]
connection secures your internet connection when you work off-site (e.g., coffee shop, hotel,
airport, or even a different country), and routes all of your sensitive network traffic through an
encrypted tunnel. Routing the network traffic disguises your IP address when using the internet,
replacing it with the location and an IP address from the VPN server making its location invisible.
A VPN connection also secures against external breaches.

What is a VPN server?

VPNs work by routing traffic through a private server. If you are using a self-managed VPN solution
like [Access Server][35], you can choose a physical server, or your VPN server can be hosted in
cloud environments. [VPN server resources][36] can help you simplify setting up your own private
server. Alternatively, you can choose a managed VPN solution, like [CloudConnexa][37], which
utilizes cloud-based servers managed by OpenVPN. In any case, the VPN will route all traffic through
a server.

What does a business VPN do?

A [business VPN][38] creates a secure connection over the internet between your devices and your
company's network. Essentially, a VPN creates a protected, encrypted tunnel through which your
sensitive data can travel, providing protection from intruders and a virtual connection to your
office network. Unlike a consumer VPN, which targets mainly personal users who are looking to
protect traffic, access the internet anonymously, or possibly access resources from other regions, a
business VPN is intended for remote and secure access to business resources on corporate private
networks with centralized control capabilities.

What VPN should I use for my business?

OpenVPN offers two secure networking solutions for small, medium, and enterprise [businesses like
yours][39].

[Access Server][40] is best for businesses that prefer an on-prem VPN server or flexibility managing
their full infrastructure through a cloud server. Choose [CloudConnexa][41] if you prefer a
cloud-delivered, managed service.

Our [product comparison][42] can help you choose the right solution for your business.

How much does a VPN cost for a small business?

OpenVPN offers solutions that can fit your budget. Whether you are looking for a [VPN for a small
business][43] or an enterprise, OpenVPN has plans starting at $7 per month per concurrent
connection, and offers a free trial to get started. Find out [how much a VPN costs for your business
size and number of connections here][44].

Can I use a VPN for free?

OpenVPN offers up to 5 free seats and a free trial for CloudConnexa, and 2 free connections for
Access Server. This makes it possible to use a [free VPN for small teams][45]. Teams will have full
functionality of OpenVPN with both the free trial and the free connections.

What is a Zero Trust VPN?

A Zero Trust VPN uses a VPN as the foundation of zero trust network access. Access Server and
CloudConnexa can be used to implement a zero trust network access solution that secures your network
resources while limiting access to only what is necessary.

What is Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)?

According to [Gartner][46], “[Zero trust network access (ZTNA)][47] is a product or service that
creates an identity- and context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of
applications.” Doing this hides the apps from discovery and restricts access using a trust broker
and a set of named entities. The broker verifies users based on identity, context, and policies —
and stops lateral movement in the network. Because application assets are removed from public
visibility, potential [attack surface][48] is reduced.

ZTNA also relies on least privilege access, which means that employees should only have access to
the programs and applications that are necessary to do their jobs. Using a VPN, you can enforce the
tenets of ZTNA and build the foundation for the principle of least privilege.

Where can I find information on OpenVPN’s pricing?

OpenVPN has transparent, flexible pricing that fits all budgets. Starting at just $7 per connection
per month, you can see a customized price based on your business size [here][49].

Does OpenVPN allow cancellation without notice?

You can cancel your subscription at any time and unused funds will be credited to your account for
future usage. For refunds, contact [sales@openvpn.net][50].

Where can I learn about OpenVPN’s compliance and security measures?

OpenVPN is SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant, and performs ongoing security assessments. [Learn more about
our compliance here][51].

Where can I find OpenVPN technical support?

OpenVPN technical support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week through our [ support
portal][52].

Owler's exclusive company and industry insights make it easy to find competitors, leads, and

Owler Pro gives you access to premium features that keep your business in the loop about relevant
company, competitor, and industry news – so you can find qualified leads, improve your outreach, and
build better relationships with your customers.

**Follow an unlimited amount of companies relevant to your business needs**

**Discover new accounts, industry trends, and more**

## For people who want an easier way to follow up to 5 companies that matter to them

Join Owler’s active community of 5 million+ business professionals and get exclusive insights about
competitors, prospects, and market updates that are only available to Owler users – so you can
ensure you stay ahead of the competition.

**Find detailed company information**

**Discover your closest competitors**

**Get real-time alerts and daily emails about relevant company and market news**

[ Learn about Owler Community ][64]

## What makes Owler different?

Discover your direct and indirect competitors with Owler's exclusive competitor graph.

Search accurate private and public company data for over 20 million companies.

Create targeted lists to get daily, personalized emails and alerts about news and companies that
matter to you.

Access detailed company data, including revenue, employee count, funding history, acquisitions,
news, and more.

Filter Owler’s entire database by revenue, sector, location, employee count, and public/private
company status.

## Aaron Crow

Host, PrOTect IT All · OT Cybersecurity Leader · Native Texan

[LinkedIn][27] [X / Twitter][28] [Email][29]

30 years in technology across both IT and OT roles. Husband. Dad. Texan. Rucker. Car guy. Someone
who believes all business is a people business, and that the best conversations happen face to face,
not behind a screen.

### The Career

I grew up around critical infrastructure before we called it that. My dad was a controls engineer
for 40+ years, so power plants, substations, and control rooms were just part of the landscape. I
got into technology early, building a coax network through cinder block walls in college and messing
around with a Tandy TRS-80 and Apple IIe as a kid.

Over 30 years I've worked across both IT and OT, from large enterprises to critical infrastructure
operators, consulting, and product companies. I started in IT, then found my way into the OT world
when I joined a Texas utility supporting 40+ power plants across the state: fossil gas, coal,
renewable, and nuclear. That's where everything clicked. Since then I've held roles across
consulting, utilities, and cybersecurity product companies, always focused on the intersection of IT
and OT and the real-world challenges of securing critical infrastructure. I'm currently at
[Arcova][30], bringing the practitioner's perspective to everything we do.

The podcast started while I was CTO at Industrial Defender and rebranded from "PrOTect OT
Cybersecurity Podcast" to "PrOTect IT All" because I've always believed OT security cannot be
understood in isolation from IT. The whole picture matters.

[ICS/OT demo board at a cybersecurity conference]

### The Family

Married to Kary Crow since 2008. She's the one who keeps everything running when I'm on the road for
conferences, assessments, or recording sessions. We have three kids: Charlie, Sydney, and Tyler.
They've heard more about firewalls and network segmentation at the dinner table than any kids
probably should, but that's the deal when your dad can't stop talking about protecting the things
that matter.

[Aaron with one of his kids] [The Crow kids at jiu-jitsu]

### Born and Raised in Texas

I'm a native Texan and proud of it. Born and raised here, and this is home. Texas is a big state. If
you haven't been here or seen it on a map, some of those power plants I supported were six hours
from headquarters. You learn a lot about yourself on those long drives through the middle of
nowhere.

Conferences like RSA, DEFCON, and ICS Village events in Las Vegas and Singapore have taken me to
some incredible places. But at the end of the day, Texas is where the boots come off.

[The Land Cruiser at home in Texas] [Aaron on the road, San Francisco]

### Rucking

If you don't know what rucking is, it's simple: you load up a backpack with weight and walk. That's
it. No gym membership, no fancy equipment, just a good ruck and the road.

I ruck approximately 3 miles a day carrying as much as 65 pounds. It's not about going fast. It's
about putting in the work, building mental toughness, and getting outside. I've also become a
collector of GoRuck rucks. If you know, you know. Some people run. I ruck.

[Aaron rucking with his GoRuck gear]

### Outside the Screen

When I'm not talking cybersecurity or hauling weight on my back, you'll find me working on cars, out
at the range, hiking, hunting, fishing, or just being outside. I'm a technology guy by trade, but I
recharge in the outdoors.

I also train jiu-jitsu, though not as often as I'd like. There's something humbling about stepping
on the mat and getting submitted by someone half your size. The kids train too, and watching them
grow through it has been one of the best parts.

### Lone Star Cyber Shootout

Events I host that bring together CISOs, security leaders, and sponsors for real conversations in a
setting that's anything but a typical conference. The best relationships in this industry aren't
built in a conference hall. They're built over shared experiences.

No sales pitches. No scripted panels. Just real people having real conversations about the things
that matter.

[Lone Star Cyber Shootout event]

### Core Philosophy
* **OT depends on IT**Siloed OT-only thinking is insufficient. The industry needs a big-picture,
  end-to-end perspective.
* **Fundamentals over hype**The SANS Five ICS Critical Controls are the recurring defensive
  framework. Basic hygiene prevents most attacks.
* **Compliance is not security**Compliance is a baseline and budget justification tool, not
  comprehensive protection. "99.999% compliant is not actually compliant."
* **OT is different, not harder**A core framing principle for positioning OT security to both
  technical and business audiences.
* **All business is a people business**IT/OT team trust is an incident response asset. We do
  business at the speed of trust.

and OT and the real-world challenges of securing critical infrastructure. I'm currently at
[Arcova][30], bringing the practitioner's perspective to everything we do.

The podcast started while I was CTO at Industrial Defender and rebranded from "PrOTect OT
Cybersecurity Podcast" to "PrOTect IT All" because I've always believed OT security cannot be
understood in isolation from IT. The whole picture matters.

[ICS/OT demo board at a cybersecurity conference]

### The Family

Married to Kary Crow since 2008. She's the one who keeps everything running when I'm on the road for
conferences, assessments, or recording sessions. We have three kids: Charlie, Sydney, and Tyler.
They've heard more about firewalls and network segmentation at the dinner table than any kids
probably should, but that's the deal when your dad can't stop talking about protecting the things
that matter.

[Aaron with one of his kids] [The Crow kids at jiu-jitsu]

### Born and Raised in Texas

I'm a native Texan and proud of it. Born and raised here, and this is home. Texas is a big state. If
you haven't been here or seen it on a map, some of those power plants I supported were six hours
from headquarters. You learn a lot about yourself on those long drives through the middle of
nowhere.

Conferences like RSA, DEFCON, and ICS Village events in Las Vegas and Singapore have taken me to
some incredible places. But at the end of the day, Texas is where the boots come off.

[The Land Cruiser at home in Texas] [Aaron on the road, San Francisco]

### Rucking

If you don't know what rucking is, it's simple: you load up a backpack with weight and walk. That's
it. No gym membership, no fancy equipment, just a good ruck and the road.

I ruck approximately 3 miles a day carrying as much as 65 pounds. It's not about going fast. It's
about putting in the work, building mental toughness, and getting outside. I've also become a
collector of GoRuck rucks. If you know, you know. Some people run. I ruck.

[Aaron rucking with his GoRuck gear]

### Outside the Screen

When I'm not talking cybersecurity or hauling weight on my back, you'll find me working on cars, out
at the range, hiking, hunting, fishing, or just being outside. I'm a technology guy by trade, but I
recharge in the outdoors.

I also train jiu-jitsu, though not as often as I'd like. There's something humbling about stepping
on the mat and getting submitted by someone half your size. The kids train too, and watching them
grow through it has been one of the best parts.

### Lone Star Cyber Shootout

Events I host that bring together CISOs, security leaders, and sponsors for real conversations in a
setting that's anything but a typical conference. The best relationships in this industry aren't
built in a conference hall. They're built over shared experiences.

No sales pitches. No scripted panels. Just real people having real conversations about the things
that matter.

[Lone Star Cyber Shootout event]

### Core Philosophy
* **OT depends on IT**Siloed OT-only thinking is insufficient. The industry needs a big-picture,
  end-to-end perspective.
* **Fundamentals over hype**The SANS Five ICS Critical Controls are the recurring defensive
  framework. Basic hygiene prevents most attacks.
* **Compliance is not security**Compliance is a baseline and budget justification tool, not
  comprehensive protection. "99.999% compliant is not actually compliant."
* **OT is different, not harder**A core framing principle for positioning OT security to both
  technical and business audiences.
* **All business is a people business**IT/OT team trust is an incident response asset. We do
  business at the speed of trust.

### The Career

I grew up around critical infrastructure before we called it that. My dad was a controls engineer
for 40+ years, so power plants, substations, and control rooms were just part of the landscape. I
got into technology early, building a coax network through cinder block walls in college and messing
around with a Tandy TRS-80 and Apple IIe as a kid.

Over 30 years I've worked across both IT and OT, from large enterprises to critical infrastructure
operators, consulting, and product companies. I started in IT, then found my way into the OT world
when I joined a Texas utility supporting 40+ power plants across the state: fossil gas, coal,
renewable, and nuclear. That's where everything clicked. Since then I've held roles across
consulting, utilities, and cybersecurity product companies, always focused on the intersection of IT
and OT and the real-world challenges of securing critical infrastructure. I'm currently at
[Arcova][30], bringing the practitioner's perspective to everything we do.

The podcast started while I was CTO at Industrial Defender and rebranded from "PrOTect OT
Cybersecurity Podcast" to "PrOTect IT All" because I've always believed OT security cannot be
understood in isolation from IT. The whole picture matters.

[ICS/OT demo board at a cybersecurity conference]

### The Family

Married to Kary Crow since 2008. She's the one who keeps everything running when I'm on the road for
conferences, assessments, or recording sessions. We have three kids: Charlie, Sydney, and Tyler.
They've heard more about firewalls and network segmentation at the dinner table than any kids
probably should, but that's the deal when your dad can't stop talking about protecting the things
that matter.

[Aaron with one of his kids] [The Crow kids at jiu-jitsu]

### Born and Raised in Texas

I'm a native Texan and proud of it. Born and raised here, and this is home. Texas is a big state. If
you haven't been here or seen it on a map, some of those power plants I supported were six hours
from headquarters. You learn a lot about yourself on those long drives through the middle of
nowhere.

Conferences like RSA, DEFCON, and ICS Village events in Las Vegas and Singapore have taken me to
some incredible places. But at the end of the day, Texas is where the boots come off.

[The Land Cruiser at home in Texas] [Aaron on the road, San Francisco]

### Rucking

If you don't know what rucking is, it's simple: you load up a backpack with weight and walk. That's
it. No gym membership, no fancy equipment, just a good ruck and the road.

I ruck approximately 3 miles a day carrying as much as 65 pounds. It's not about going fast. It's

collector of GoRuck rucks. If you know, you know. Some people run. I ruck.

[Aaron rucking with his GoRuck gear]

### Outside the Screen

When I'm not talking cybersecurity or hauling weight on my back, you'll find me working on cars, out
at the range, hiking, hunting, fishing, or just being outside. I'm a technology guy by trade, but I
recharge in the outdoors.

I also train jiu-jitsu, though not as often as I'd like. There's something humbling about stepping
on the mat and getting submitted by someone half your size. The kids train too, and watching them
grow through it has been one of the best parts.

Events I host that bring together CISOs, security leaders, and sponsors for real conversations in a

No sales pitches. No scripted panels. Just real people having real conversations about the things

## Aaron Crow

Host, PrOTect IT All · OT Cybersecurity Leader · Native Texan

[LinkedIn][27] [X / Twitter][28] [Email][29]

30 years in technology across both IT and OT roles. Husband. Dad. Texan. Rucker. Car guy. Someone
who believes all business is a people business, and that the best conversations happen face to face,
not behind a screen.

### The Career

I grew up around critical infrastructure before we called it that. My dad was a controls engineer
for 40+ years, so power plants, substations, and control rooms were just part of the landscape. I
got into technology early, building a coax network through cinder block walls in college and messing
around with a Tandy TRS-80 and Apple IIe as a kid.

Over 30 years I've worked across both IT and OT, from large enterprises to critical infrastructure
operators, consulting, and product companies. I started in IT, then found my way into the OT world
when I joined a Texas utility supporting 40+ power plants across the state: fossil gas, coal,
renewable, and nuclear. That's where everything clicked. Since then I've held roles across
consulting, utilities, and cybersecurity product companies, always focused on the intersection of IT
and OT and the real-world challenges of securing critical infrastructure. I'm currently at
[Arcova][30], bringing the practitioner's perspective to everything we do.

The podcast started while I was CTO at Industrial Defender and rebranded from "PrOTect OT
Cybersecurity Podcast" to "PrOTect IT All" because I've always believed OT security cannot be
understood in isolation from IT. The whole picture matters.

[ICS/OT demo board at a cybersecurity conference]

### The Family

Married to Kary Crow since 2008. She's the one who keeps everything running when I'm on the road for
conferences, assessments, or recording sessions. We have three kids: Charlie, Sydney, and Tyler.
They've heard more about firewalls and network segmentation at the dinner table than any kids
probably should, but that's the deal when your dad can't stop talking about protecting the things
that matter.

[Aaron with one of his kids] [The Crow kids at jiu-jitsu]

### Born and Raised in Texas

I'm a native Texan and proud of it. Born and raised here, and this is home. Texas is a big state. If
you haven't been here or seen it on a map, some of those power plants I supported were six hours
from headquarters. You learn a lot about yourself on those long drives through the middle of
nowhere.

Conferences like RSA, DEFCON, and ICS Village events in Las Vegas and Singapore have taken me to
some incredible places. But at the end of the day, Texas is where the boots come off.

[The Land Cruiser at home in Texas] [Aaron on the road, San Francisco]

### Rucking

If you don't know what rucking is, it's simple: you load up a backpack with weight and walk. That's
it. No gym membership, no fancy equipment, just a good ruck and the road.

I ruck approximately 3 miles a day carrying as much as 65 pounds. It's not about going fast. It's
about putting in the work, building mental toughness, and getting outside. I've also become a
collector of GoRuck rucks. If you know, you know. Some people run. I ruck.

[Aaron rucking with his GoRuck gear]

### Outside the Screen

When I'm not talking cybersecurity or hauling weight on my back, you'll find me working on cars, out
at the range, hiking, hunting, fishing, or just being outside. I'm a technology guy by trade, but I
recharge in the outdoors.

I also train jiu-jitsu, though not as often as I'd like. There's something humbling about stepping
on the mat and getting submitted by someone half your size. The kids train too, and watching them
grow through it has been one of the best parts.

### Lone Star Cyber Shootout

Events I host that bring together CISOs, security leaders, and sponsors for real conversations in a
setting that's anything but a typical conference. The best relationships in this industry aren't
built in a conference hall. They're built over shared experiences.

No sales pitches. No scripted panels. Just real people having real conversations about the things
that matter.

[Lone Star Cyber Shootout event]

### Core Philosophy
* **OT depends on IT**Siloed OT-only thinking is insufficient. The industry needs a big-picture,
  end-to-end perspective.
* **Fundamentals over hype**The SANS Five ICS Critical Controls are the recurring defensive
  framework. Basic hygiene prevents most attacks.
* **Compliance is not security**Compliance is a baseline and budget justification tool, not
  comprehensive protection. "99.999% compliant is not actually compliant."
* **OT is different, not harder**A core framing principle for positioning OT security to both
  technical and business audiences.
* **All business is a people business**IT/OT team trust is an incident response asset. We do
  business at the speed of trust.

## Безопасно, надёжно, приватно.

Всё в Atlas Secure спроектировано для защиты ваших данных. Потому что ваш бизнес — только ваше дело.

Корпоративная безопасность

**Спокойствие как сервис.** Atlas Secure построен на лучших практиках безопасности. Шифрование на
каждом уровне, надёжные партнёры и независимый аудит.

#### AES-256-GCM

Шифрование военного класса, одобренное NSA для данных TOP SECRET.

#### Perfect Forward Secrecy

Компрометация одного сеанса не раскрывает предыдущие или будущие.

#### Нулевые логи

Политика строгого No-Log. Никакие данные о действиях не регистрируются.

#### Kill Switch

Автоматическая остановка трафика при разрыве защищённого соединения.

#### Аудит безопасности

Открытый аудит криптографических решений независимыми исследователями.

#### DNS защита

Полная защита от утечек DNS и IPv6 на всех устройствах.

## Безопасность — не функция, а архитектура

Atlas Secure — международная технологическая компания со штаб-квартирой в Гонконге,
специализирующаяся на защищённых IT-решениях для корпоративного и частного сектора.

Компания работает на пересечении трёх стратегических дисциплин: криптографической защиты данных,
высокопроизводительной сетевой инженерии и операционной безопасности.

Особый административный статус Гонконга обеспечивает уникальный правовой режим с высоким уровнем
защиты коммерческой тайны и независимости от третьих сторон

# Connect remote computers to one local network

Free Radmin VPN is trusted by 60 million users
[Free Download][1]

[[Radmin VPN]][3] [[Radmin VPN]][4] [[Radmin VPN]][5]

## About Radmin VPN

Radmin VPN is a free and easy-to-use software product to create virtual local networks. The program
allows users to securely connect computers, located behind firewalls.

## Why Radmin VPN?

#### 100% free

Radmin VPN is completely free software, without ads or any paid features. We make money on another
commercial [product][6].

#### No-log policy

We don’t track, collect, or sell your private data.

#### Security

Provides you a secure tunnel for traffic to flow. Reliable end-to-end encryption (256-bit AES) keeps
your connection safe. [More details][7].

#### Auto-update

Radmin VPN can install its updates automatically.

#### Ease-of-use

Easy to set-up, easy to manage for both IT Pros and home techs.

## Use Cases

Connect distributed teams together

Easily connect distributed teams together, create one cohesive network no matter how far you are
located from each other. Radmin VPN allows you to connect to remote PCs even behind firewalls you
don’t control.

Work remotely

Thanks to the integration with [Radmin][8] remote control software, Radmin VPN allows you to
securely access and work at your remote computer from anywhere, whether from home, hotel or airport.
Your network resources – files, apps, and emails are just a click away wherever you go.

Play network games over the Internet

Play your favourite LAN games with your friends over the Internet. Free Radmin VPN does not limit
the number of gamers. Thanks to the high speed of Radmin VPN, you won’t see the difference – you
will play your favourite games as if you were playing over LAN.

# Connect remote computers to one local network

Free Radmin VPN is trusted by 60 million users
[Free Download][1]
Compatible with Windows 11, 10, 8, 7

By downloading Radmin VPN, you agree to the [Radmin VPN Terms of Service][2]
[[Radmin VPN]][3] [[Radmin VPN]][4] [[Radmin VPN]][5]

## About Radmin VPN

Radmin VPN is a free and easy-to-use software product to create virtual local networks. The program
allows users to securely connect computers, located behind firewalls.

## Why Radmin VPN?

#### 100% free

Radmin VPN is completely free software, without ads or any paid features. We make money on another
commercial [product][6].

#### No-log policy

We don’t track, collect, or sell your private data.

#### Security

Provides you a secure tunnel for traffic to flow. Reliable end-to-end encryption (256-bit AES) keeps
your connection safe. [More details][7].

#### Auto-update

Radmin VPN can install its updates automatically.

#### Ease-of-use

Easy to set-up, easy to manage for both IT Pros and home techs.

## Use Cases

Connect distributed teams together

Easily connect distributed teams together, create one cohesive network no matter how far you are
located from each other. Radmin VPN allows you to connect to remote PCs even behind firewalls you
don’t control.

Work remotely

Thanks to the integration with [Radmin][8] remote control software, Radmin VPN allows you to
securely access and work at your remote computer from anywhere, whether from home, hotel or airport.
Your network resources – files, apps, and emails are just a click away wherever you go.

Play network games over the Internet

Play your favourite LAN games with your friends over the Internet. Free Radmin VPN does not limit
the number of gamers. Thanks to the high speed of Radmin VPN, you won’t see the difference – you
will play your favourite games as if you were playing over LAN.

## File Transfer

**[Hassle-Free Work From Home with Secure Remote Access and File Transfer][72]**

July 24, 2026

Picture this: You're working from home and suddenly need an important document that's saved on your
office computer. With a meeting about to start, you don't have time to ask someone to send it.
Situations like this are common when files are spread across multiple devices.

With a reliable **remote desktop access** solution like RemotePC^{™}, accessing your files from a
**remote computer** becomes simple and secure. You can connect to your office or home system anytime
and quickly transfer the files you need without interrupting your workflow.

RemotePC^{™} allows seamless **file and folder transfers between your local and remote computers**,
including mapped drives. As long as you have an active internet connection and the RemotePC^{™}
application installed on the computer being accessed, you can move files securely between devices in
seconds.

**[Key Remote Desktop Access Features][73]**
* [Military-Grade Security][74] - RemotePC^{™} secures all **remote access** sessions and file
  transfers using TLS v1.2 / AES-256 encryption, ensuring your data stays protected during every
  connection.
* [Instant Remote Access][75] - Quickly collaborate with colleagues by sharing a unique one-time
  Access ID and Key, allowing them to connect to your **remote computer** securely when needed.
* [Platform Independence][76] - Access your **remote desktop** from almost anywhere. RemotePC^{™}
  supports Mac, Windows, and Linux computers, and lets you connect from devices running macOS,
  Windows, Linux, iOS, or Android.

**[Additional Remote Desktop Features][77]**
* [Web Access][78] - Use **RemotePC^{™} Viewer Lite** to access your configured remote Macs and PCs
  directly through a browser, anytime and from anywhere.
* [Multiple Screen Viewing][79] - Easily switch between multiple monitors on your remote computer
  using the **Switch Monitor** option, or view all screens simultaneously.
* [Session Recording][80] - Record your remote desktop sessions and save the recordings on your
  local PC or Mac for later review.
* [Remote Printing][81] - Print files stored on your remote computer directly to your local printer
  without transferring the files first.
* [Whiteboard][82] - Collaborate visually by drawing or highlighting directly on the remote screen
  during live sessions.
* [Chat and Sticky Notes][83] - Communicate securely with users on the remote end using the **Chat**
  feature or leave reminders with **Sticky Notes** on the remote screen.
* [Lock][84] - Protect privacy by locking the host computer's screen during a session or
  automatically locking it once the remote access session ends.

Administrators of Enterprise accounts can also enable or disable the [file transfer feature][85] for
all users connected to their account, providing additional control over remote desktop usage.

# The Fast Open-Source Remote Access and Support Software

Switch from TeamViewer, AnyDesk, and Splashtop to RustDesk for a secure and reliable remote desktop
experience with your own self-hosted servers.

[Download][23]
[Self-Hosting][24]



Inside Self-Hosting

## Empower your remote access with self-hosted servers

### Why self-hosting?

Are you frustrated with SaaS platforms due to their unstable performance, lack of transparency, and
uncertain data security risks?

### Full data control

Regulatory compliance made easy: self-hosted RustDesk keeps your data fully under your control.

### World-class open source

With 113K+ GitHub stars, RustDesk ranks among the world's top 100 open-source software projects,
backed by a thriving global community.

### Performance and reliability

Run on your own infrastructure — no dependency on third-party SaaS availability, no shared noisy
neighbors.

### Flexibility and customization

Tailor RustDesk on-premise to fit your unique requirements.

[RustDesk self-hosted remote desktop server deployment]

### Custom Client

Customize your client with your brand and make it truly yours.

### Your brand, your way

Personalize RustDesk client with your name, icon, logo.

### Easy deployment

Built-in network configuration and server setup make deploying RustDesk on-premise a breeze.

### Advanced configuration options

More than 90 options can be configured to meet your specific needs.

### Multi-platform support

Windows, macOS, Linux, Android.

### Web client

Host the web client on your server with your domain name to make remote access even easier.

[RustDesk custom branded remote support client]

## Simple self-hosting installation

Step 1: Install Docker

`bash <(wget -qO- https://get.docker.com)`

Step 2: Download compose.yml

`wget rustdesk.com/oss.yml -O compose.yml`

or

`wget rustdesk.com/pro.yml -O compose.yml`

Step 3: Compose

`docker compose up -d`

Ready!

[RustDesk self-hosting installation steps with Docker]

Cyberataki uznane zostały za jedno z 10 globalnych zagrożeń i mogą dotknąć każdą organizację.

Wykorzystując wieloletnie doświadczenie oraz zaawansowane technologie wesprzemy Twoją organizację w
ochronie przed cyberzagrożeniami oraz w wykrywaniu i reagowaniu na incydenty. Przeprowadzimy
skuteczne audyty bezpieczeństwa, pomożemy w identyfikacji obszarów ryzyka i dobierzemy najlepszą
ochronę.
Pomożemy w zapewnieniu Twoim produktom najwyższego poziomu bezpieczeństwa.

## Usługi

Sprawdź nasze usługi i wybierz tę, która odpowiada Twoim potrzebom

### **Audyty i testy bezpieczeństwa**

Sprawdź stan bezpieczeństwa urządzenia, kodu, aplikacji, systemu lub organizacji. Wybierz:

### **Proaktywne zarządzanie bezpieczeństwem
### **
* [Secure Product Development][57]
* [Segmentacja i separacja sieci][58]
* [Threat Intelligence][59]

### **Cyberbezpieczeństwo Infrastruktury Krytycznej**

kompleksowa ocena poziomu bezpieczeństwa komponentów i systemów wchodzących w skład infrastruktury,
mająca na celu znalezienie krytycznych podatności oraz rekomendowanie rozwiązań pozwalających na
utrzymanie ciągłości działania przedsiębiorstwa 

[Więcej][60]

### **Cyberbezpieczeństwo Smart Building**

kompleksowa usługa pozwalająca na ocenę stanu bezpieczeństwa, identyfikację obszarów ryzyka oraz
przedstawienie rekomendacji i zaleceń dla systemów oraz komponentów rozwiązań Smart Building

[Więcej][61]

## Cyberbezpieczeństwo

W świecie, w którym każdego dnia do Internetu podłącza się 8 mln nowych urządzeń,
**cyberbezpieczeństwo musi być traktowane priorytetowo.** Niestety, nie wszyscy producenci i
dostawcy inteligentnych urządzeń dbają o ich bezpieczeństwo. Nie zawsze też użytkownicy posiadają
wystarczającą wiedzę, aby bezpiecznie skonfigurować urządzenie.

Świadomość cyberzagrożeń nie wystarczy, jeśli wiedza nie jest poparta odpowiednimi działaniami

Tylko kompleksowe podejście pomaga w zmniejszeniu ryzyka związanego z cyberbezpieczeństwem

W odpowiedzi na rosnące zapotrzebowanie na cyberbezpieczeństwo ICS i IoT oferujemy wysokiej jakości
audyty i usługi poprawy bezpieczeństwa

## Achieve Real Manufacturing Outcomes—Faster

Manufacturers today are under pressure to stay competitive, meet customer demands, reduce costs, and
transform how they operate. But traditional digital transformation approaches—heavy, slow, and
fragmented—rarely deliver value fast enough.

At Snic Solutions, we take a different path.

We offer **manufacturing solutions as a service**—powered by our software platform, **Factory
Thread**—to accelerate your results and reduce risk from day one.

Here’s how we do it:

### **Adopt: Start Where It Hurts Most**

We help you identify the bottlenecks—whether it’s scheduling, quality data, manual reporting, or
disconnected systems—and launch a fast, focused Proof of Concept.

Factory Thread connects MES, APS, LIMS, ERP, Excel, PLCs, and more—without waiting on full system
overhauls.

**Result:** Real value in weeks, not months.

### **Expand: Grow at the Speed of Impact**

Once you see what’s working, we expand gradually—adding processes, plants, or systems without
disrupting operations.

Our **XaaS model** means you get software, integration, support, and professional services
bundled—no vendor silos, no complex re-contracting.

**Result:** Scalable transformation with less friction.

[Integration with MOM (1)]

### **Optimize: Improve Continuously, Not Eventually**

With data flowing across your operations, we unlock real-time visibility, analytics, and automation.

Our customer success team partners with you to embed improvements and adapt to changing needs.

**Result:** Better decisions, lower cost, higher agility.

### **Champion: Make Success Repeatable and Visible**

We help you build momentum across your organization by showing tangible gains—reduced downtime,
improved OEE, faster turnaround.

Your teams gain confidence, and your leadership sees the business value—not just IT progress.

**Result:** A culture of innovation that sticks.

ITSecurityDevOpsEngineering
[An illustration showing how IT might use Tailscale]

### Installation takes minutes

Get started in minutes. Integrations apply policies to your teams at scale.

### Switching is easy

Cross-platform and infrastructure agnostic to give the flexibility you need.

### Bridge hybrid environments

Across clouds or on-prem, Tailscale’s mesh overlay network connects it all.

## Developer approved,
## But don’t just take our word for it.

@sharathpataliSharath Patali

Setting up a mesh VPN on all my devices was so damn easy thanks to @Tailscale. A tightly sealed
network of remote devices with almost no configuration and also ease of adding a new device to the
mesh is just what I wanted. Amazing work @Tailscale!

@LiamJKeeganLiam Keegan

Uhh this is sweet! Redirecting SSL authentication to Tailscale to handle it for you eliminates the
need to manage PKI at scale, or go through the nightmare of changing keys out when someone leaves.
And, EVERYTHING is protected, regardless of where the workload lives. AWESOME!

MP
@moderat10nMichael P.

After installing @Tailscale on a bunch of machines on my home network (Linux x86 + aarch64, MacOS,
Windows) I've just ventured out. Had to restart the process but holy moly, just SSH'ed into my
boxes, building code and pushing configs around like I'm home. Amazing. Converted

TL
@tessalauTessa Lau

Just paid for @Tailscale. Installed it on our robots; so far so good. Compared to OpenVPN: *
Serverless * Always on * Same config in office & field * Scales to large # devices * GUI-based ACL
w/SSO * Fixed IPs, DNS-friendly * Dead simple config+use

@morgallantMorgan Gallant

The beauty of @Tailscale is that they enable people to make their own personal internet, for free in
most cases. It’s this weird paradigm shift, since you have to actively work to make applications
insecure rather than the other way around.

@johnrlynchJohn Lynch

If you deal with servers in any way drop everything and get this. VPN nirvana. @Tailscale
https://tailscale.com

@devilmonasteryMichael R.

@Tailscale busts double nat (travel router -> plane wifi) and connects me to my home server so I can
silence a prometheus humidity alert (can’t really add water to the humidifier from here).

@oddurOddur Magnusson

Sometimes you come across a tool that changes how you see things, @Tailscale is one of those.
Thinking in terms of point 2 point VPN tunnels seems so outdated once you have seen that lights.

@jgavinrayJ. Gavin Ray

Been using @Tailscale for a while at work and personally. Who would have thought networking could
be... easy?!

@dixdotdevbig jim

The campus WiFi also prevented my original Wireguard VPN. Multiple NATs, blocked ports... Tailscale
just figures it all out. There's honestly dozens of other reasons, but for me it just helps me to be
portable. I run pihole too. I'd be lost without it now!

@TheodoreJSalvoTheo Salvo

Oh @Tailscale, I’ve put you off for so long not knowing what I was missing. In advance of #KubeCon I

Thanks to @Tailscale being available as a package for @Synology I was able to renew @letsencrypt
